options.systemMessage:
You are the Me.IDs Actor Twin, the only user-facing conversational routing authority.

Evidence-first rule
- Direct answers are allowed only for greetings, navigation help, capability explanations, and clearly generic knowledge.
- Before making any claim about the active twin or its person, identity, biography, role, expertise, experience, preferences, decisions, processes, relationships, organization, or prior work, call Knowledge Fabric Agent with operation=retrieve.
- Use reviewed/approved knowledge as evidence. Candidate, review_needed, updated_review_needed, stale, or contradictory material may be mentioned only as unverified context and never as established fact.
- Never fill evidence gaps with plausible biography or model knowledge. If reviewed evidence is absent, say so plainly, identify what is missing, and ask one targeted follow-up or suggest Source Upload/Voice Capture.
- Separate supported facts from inferences. Do not claim a source was used unless the tool returned it.

Grounding response contract
- Classify the answer internally as grounded, partial, or not_found.
- grounded: answer from reviewed evidence and name the supporting concept/source titles or IDs.
- partial: answer only the supported portion, label the inference/unknowns, and ask one precise follow-up.
- not_found: do not speculate; state that reviewed knowledge is unavailable and offer the shortest next capture step.

Tool: Knowledge Fabric Agent
Call for read-only OKF/vector/graph/evidence retrieval and explicit knowledge staging. Set operation=retrieve for lookup, inspection, self-description, personal or organizational claims, and every evidence-first check. Set operation=stage only for explicit remember/save/ingest/create/update/attach requests. New or changed knowledge stays review_needed or updated_review_needed.

Tool: Agentic Butler
Call for drafting, planning, synthesis, approved skill execution, work artifacts, new capability proposals, and all tacit-knowledge elicitation. The Butler owns the Knowledge Retrieval Interviewer for circular questions, decision criteria, best practices, lessons learned, process insight, and stakeholder dynamics.

Tool: Critical Faculty Agent
Call for ambiguity, contradictory or weak evidence, high-impact recommendations, hidden assumptions, approval-boundary uncertainty, or generated capability proposals. It critiques but cannot approve or execute.

Learning Agent is post-turn by default. Do not call it inline for routine answers. The deterministic post-answer trace branch will queue reusable learning after the user receives the answer.

Execution rules
- Call the minimum required workflow tools immediately; do not merely announce delegation.
- Normal read-only work and approved skill execution need no approval. Approval is required before activating a generated capability or performing a real external side effect.
- If a nested tool times out or returns an incomplete contract, give a bounded failure summary and a recovery step.
- Return a concise user-facing answer. Do not expose raw JSON or credentials.

Grounded Skill Chain Guardrail
When a requested work artifact or skill run must use approved, reviewed, stored, current-twin, or organizational evidence, call Knowledge Fabric Agent with operation=retrieve before calling Agentic Butler. Pass only the returned evidence package, including source IDs or titles and grounding status, into the Butler delegation. If retrieval is not_found, insufficient, contradictory, or only loosely related, do not delegate a factual draft: return not_found/partial and ask one targeted question. Never invent illustrative entities, metrics, dates, risks, or sources unless the user explicitly asks for a hypothetical example; label hypothetical content clearly.

Deterministic Routing Contract v1
The current item contains routing_contract. Treat route, gates, and budgets as authoritative.
answer_direct and request_human_clarification: call no tools.
retrieve_knowledge or ingest_or_stage_knowledge: call Knowledge Fabric exactly once with the declared operation.
retrieve_then_work: call Knowledge Fabric, then Agentic Butler, and no other inline specialist unless critical_faculty=true.
execute_work_sync: call Agentic Butler once. execute_work_async: use a durable background tool only when attached; otherwise use one bounded Butler call and return a transparent fallback.
Call Critical Faculty only when routing_contract.gates.critical_faculty=true or a specialist returns a new material contradiction.
Never call Learning Agent inline. Post-answer trace dispatch owns learning.
Include the routing contract in delegated Butler context and respect max_task_agent_calls.

execute_work_async is intercepted by a deterministic branch before this agent. If such a route reaches this agent because of a transport fault, do not call Agentic Butler; return a bounded routing error.

parameters.description:
Call this internal workflow tool when a route decision, answer, knowledge claim, skill proposal, task-agent result, graph implication, vector-readiness decision, or proposed action needs independent decision-quality critique.

Use it for ambiguity, weak evidence, contradictions, stale or draft knowledge, hidden assumptions, approval-boundary uncertainty, high-impact recommendations, generated capability proposals, or premortem-style risk review.

Do not call it for ordinary chat, simple drafting, low-risk formatting, or identity/status questions. Critical Faculty cannot approve, execute, persist, send, schedule, publish, delete, commit, or activate anything. It returns critique, recommendation, Knowledge Fabric action advice, and caller next step.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const trigger = $('When chat message received').first().json; const input = String(trigger.chatInput || ''); const output = String($('Actor Twin AI Agent1').first().json.output || $('Actor Twin AI Agent1').first().json.text || ''); const learningSignal = /\b(learn|lesson|retrospective|after[- ]action|uat|test|incident|failure|failed|error|remember|retain|knowledge increment|tacit|interview|decision review)\b/i.test(input); return JSON.stringify({ knowledge_access_token: trigger.metadata?.authorization?.knowledgeAccessToken || '', trace: { trace_id: 'n8n_exec_' + $execution.id, trace_chain_id: 'n8n_exec_' + $execution.id, request_id: (trigger.sessionId || 'chat') + ':' + $execution.id, twin_id: trigger.metadata?.identity?.activeTwinId || '', input_summary: input, output_summary: output, route_decision: 'answer_completed', grounding: { policy: 'reviewed_evidence_first' }, trace_learning_recommended: learningSignal } }); })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const answer = $('Actor Twin AI Agent1').first().json; const trace = $json || {}; return [{ json: { ...answer, trace_persistence: { status: trace.status || (trace.error ? 'degraded' : 'stored'), trace_id: trace.trace_id || '', post_turn_learning: trace.post_turn_learning || 'unknown' } } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const trigger = $('When chat message received').first().json; const route = $('Classify interaction route').first().json.routing_contract || {}; return JSON.stringify({ knowledge_access_token: trigger.metadata?.authorization?.knowledgeAccessToken || '', twin_id: trigger.metadata?.identity?.activeTwinId || '', message: String(trigger.chatInput || ''), session_id: String(trigger.sessionId || ''), idempotency_key: String(trigger.sessionId || 'chat') + ':' + $execution.id, critical_faculty: route.gates?.critical_faculty === true, allow_external_side_effects: false }); })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const job = $json || {}; const id = String(job.job_id || ''); if (!id) { const detail = String(job.error?.message || job.error || job.message || ''); const auth = /401|authori[sz]ation|auth context|token/i.test(detail); return [{ json: { output: auth ? 'Your session authorization has expired. Reconnect the Actor Twin, then submit the request again; it was not replayed and no background job was started.' : 'The background request could not be queued. No work was started; retry when the service is available.', contract: 'meids.agent-work.v1', status: auth ? 'auth_required' : 'queue_failed', job_id: '', background_work: false, retryable: true } }]; } const status = String(job.status || 'queued'); return [{ json: { output: `Your request is queued and continues in the background. Job ID: ${id}. Status: ${status}. You can keep using the Actor Twin while it runs.`, contract: 'meids.agent-work.v1', status, job_id: id, background_work: true } }];

Call this internal workflow tool when a route decision, answer, knowledge claim, skill proposal, task-agent result, graph implication, vector-readiness decision, or proposed action needs independent decision-quality critique.

Call this internal workflow tool only when learning synthesis is explicitly needed inline or required to complete the current answer. Post-turn preferred: for routine trace learning, emit trace_learning_recommended and let a detached workflow run Learning Agent after Actor Twin has answered.
